verdict.rationale: pnpm is a package manager with no production data or hosted environment, so the closest match is its documented dry-run install mode. That mode runs full dependency resolution and reports what would change without saving any lockfile, manifest or node_modules changes. This gives an agent a safe preview mode, but it is not a true sandbox environment. Missing for 10: an isolated sandbox or test environment separate from real project state, a sandbox registry or publish target, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of agent use.
